title: Stargate Studios Virtual Backlot Reel 2009
summary: Stargate Studios' 2009 virtual backlot reel shows before-and-after shots in which green screen and compositing replace locations in ordinary TV dramas and comedies. It shows how much of a seemingly real show is computer generated.
why: HN points to it as a demo of how routinely mundane TV scenes use green screen set replacement, even on TV budgets.

quote.text: This is an amazing demo reel of effects shots used in "mundane" TV shows
